name: Invalid wildcard Service principal on a resource policy surfaces fail-closed
note: IAM-1208 (Phase 12.1, fix 4): a Service principal containing a partial '*'/'?' wildcard (ec2-*.amazonaws.com) is an INVALID Principal element - an AWS Service principal is an EXACT identifier and the element does not wildcard-match service names, so the member matches NO service. It is not a valid service grant, so the confused-deputy (service) branch never emits it and, before this fix, it was silently dropped. The evaluator now fails closed toward surfacing with one RESOURCE-UNSUPPORTED-PRINCIPAL finding (high), never presented as a normal service grant. No graph can-access edge is drawn.
